caption: The drawing depicts a potted plant with a bird perched among its branches. The pot is brown at the base and decorated with a yellow and red crisscross pattern on the upper and lower halves, respectively. The plant has dark green leaves, two large round green fruits, and small flowers that are pink and yellow. The bird has a green head, a large red patch covering its beak and breast, a brown eye and neck, and black-and-white striped wings and tail. The background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery. The entire composition is centered on an off-white or light beige background.
title: Silk Applique Quilt
